milestone: WFC mountain routes, graded volumetric passages and traversable bypasses

changes.regional_topology: 5x5 directional socket WFC with connected-cycle propagation and bounded backtracking; two distinct arcs between shared approaches.
changes.world_integration: One seeded region in asymmetric worlds, a rotated pair in symmetric worlds; protects bases, elevated roads, lakes and primary tunnel entrances.
changes.excavation: Grade WFC, eight dimension-compatible arch profiles, rounded junctions, open cuttings and real surface breaches in the shared scalar field.
changes.navigation: Sampled walkable floor spans around excavations, off-center chamber area, separate stacked floors and explicit small/large clearance masks.
changes.bypass_contract: All bypass nodes and intermediate connections must fit radius 0.86 tile / height 2.5 quarter floors; narrow passage fixtures exclude this body.
changes.interior_contract: At least four covered route samples, including a consecutive run of at least three.
changes.inspection: Mountain passage and Mountain bypass scout tours, floor overlays and isolation guides.
changes.mesher: Retains the fixed marching-tetrahedra lattice and matching collision interpolation.
changes.world_bounds: 64x64 land inside 96x96 ocean; map growth allowance recorded for future expansion.

verified: Mountain passage and bypass scout tours
Automatic terrain cutaway versus intact rock at the same camera
Actual tunnel shells with ceilings on/off in isolation
browser_review.performance_scope: Development desktop observations, not a sustained or mobile benchmark. Generation time excludes scene construction and GPU upload.

regression_repair.problem: Crowded layout exhausted 12 complete plans; first passing candidate occurred on attempt 16.
regression_repair.change: Expanded bounded layout search to 24 without removing geometry, route or clearance requirements.

limitations: The first regional grammar produces one cycle per mountain region, not arbitrary strategic graphs or a complete terrain-aware road/tunnel search.
Different seeds can have a single covered run or multiple tunnels; the interior route is not guaranteed shorter than the bypass.
Compact regions remain possible in crowded worlds; increasing map dimensions and chunked rendering are separate work.
Navigation samples two body profiles; it is not a continuous swept-volume guarantee, continuous navmesh or vehicle pathfinding API.
Hydrology, erosion, richer ridge/pass modules and a new noise library remain research directions.
The scout is scripted; this release adds no combat or trained AlienWars policy.
